'''Lelia''' is an [[NPC]] in [[Ragunna City]]. She appears at [[Trattoria Margherita]] after completing {{Quest|Margherita's Daily Special I}}. Initially a ''Waiter'', she gains the ''Commis Chef'' title after completing {{Quest|Margherita's Daily Special III}}, and later is promoted to ''Chef'' after completing {{Quest|Margherita's Daily Special VI}}.

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Lelia}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(As Waiter)
:'''Lelia:''' Don't avoid eye contact... always ask about their preferences... and don't mention [[Pizza Tropicale]] unless they do first.
:{{DIcon}} What are you muttering about?
:'''Lelia:''' Oh, nothing. Just some reminders for taking orders.
----
;(As Commis Chef)
:'''Lelia:''' Ah, why do I keep messing up! All those ingredients, just wasted...
:{{DIcon}} Learn from it and try again.
::'''Lelia:''' You're right! I'll be more careful!
:{{DIcon}} Think about why you started.
::'''Lelia:''' Why I started... I want to make food that puts smiles on people's faces.
::'''Lelia:''' I feel like I've found my courage again. Thank you.
----
;(As Chef)
:'''Lelia:''' You... recommended me to Ms. Margherita?
:{{DIcon}} Yes, but only if you are up for it.
:'''Lelia:''' Just the idea of cooking during peak hours gets me so nervous I start to shake.
:'''Lelia:''' But you taught me not to let opportunities slip by. So if the manager agrees, I'll be there.
----
:'''Lelia:''' Lately, Ms. Margherita has been sharing all sorts of cooking tips with me.
:{{DIcon}} What kind of tips?
:'''Lelia:''' Hmm, like this: "Simple is best! Don't be crammin' every flavor into one dish.
:'''Lelia:''' Or "Seasoning isn't just one or two steps. It should be added from start to finish.
:{{DIcon}} You even picked up her way of talking.
:'''Lelia:''' Oops! I guess I've been going over her tips so much that it's starting to rub off on me...
:'''Lelia:''' But the best lesson I learned was from you—"be brave and take that first step.
:{{DIcon}} Did I really say that?
:'''Lelia:''' For you it was probably just a kind word, but for me, it meant everything.
:'''Lelia:''' Ah, now I'm just babbling…
{{Dialogue End}}
